name: Plague Doctor Gangsta's Paradise
look: A blurry phone video still of a person dressed as a plague doctor, in a long black hooded robe and mask, striding forward with a walking cane under an open picnic shelter, with a red building, a picnic table and green grass behind.
use: A slow, menacing entrance. The caption sets up a moment, and the costumed figure is whoever shows up uninvited and ready to deal with it, like a parent who hears one cough or the IT guy arriving after you touched something.
slots: caption saying who is arriving and when (top)
examples: The school nurse walking in after I mention a tiny headache
The IT guy after I say I didn't touch anything

creepy figure in a dark robe and mask striding forward
someone in a hooded black outfit walking menacingly
